item.title: Like Many Who Grew Up With 'Toy Story,' Woody Is Balding In The New 'Toy Story 5' Trailer
item.description: Balding Woody is a reaction image meme of Woody from the Toy Story 5 trailer taking his hat off and looking downward from a behind-the-back angle, revealing that he is balding. The trailer was released on February 19th, 2026 and the balding scene inspired reactions and memes about going bald on social media.

item.title: Why is TikTok Flooded With Videos of Jeffrey Epstein Dancing? Trend Explained
item.description: Jeffery Epstein Dance Videos refers to the proliferation of AI-generated videos, particularly on TikTok, depicting convicted sex trafficker Jeffrey Epstein dancing, often salaciously, to popular music and re-creating popular dance trends. The videos began to appear on the platform as AI models became more powerful and accessible, reaching peak popularity in late 2025 to early 2026.

item.title: Why Is This Kid's Song Going Viral?
item.description: My Furry Valentine is a children's song produced for the Disney Jr. short series Minnie's Bow-Toons: Pet Hotel, where Minnie Mouse sings to her pets for Valentine's Day. The song went viral on TikTok and stan twitter in February 2026 for its perceived musical similarities to adult-oriented pop acts like PinkPanthress and NewJeans.

item.title: What Does "Withered" Mean? Internet Slang Explained
item.description: Withered refers to a meme derived from the Five Nights at Freddy's video game franchise. The meme typically utilizes the decomposed design of the "withered" animatronic variants that appear in Five Nights at Freddy's 2, adopting the decayed aesthetic for characters or persons outside of the FNAF universe. "Withered" has also been adopted as a popular internet slang to describe the diminished state of someone or something.

item.title: 'Evan Burger' Clip From 2021 Anthology Series 'Just Beyond' Becomes A Brainrot Meme On Reels, TikTok
item.description: Evan Burger or Did He Just Say That His Last Name Is Burger? is a series of brainrot memes based on a scene from the 2021 anthology TV series Just Beyond where a school bully, Trevor Larkin, makes fun of a new student named Evan Burger after he introduces himself to the class, poking fun at him for having the last name "Burger."
